main_text.p: Israelitis tollitote. Si quis puellam virginem viro pastam nactus in oppido copresserit, ambos ad illius oppidi portam eductos lapidatote, & necatote puellam, quia in oppido non clamaverit: virum, quia alterius uxorem subegerit: id nefas de medio vestrum tollitote. Sin autem ruri puellam desponsatam nactus vir, ei vim intulerit, eamq; compresserit, mor tor vir ille tantum, qui eam compressit: puella autem nihil nocetote, neq; enim in capitali crimine est: hoc enim perinde est, ac si quis alterū aggressus vita privet. Nam ruri eam reperit, neque clamanti puella desponsa adfuit, qui succurreret. Si quis puellam virgine non desponsam nactus, ei stupru intulerit, & deprehensi fuerint, vir ille patri puellae quinquaginta argenteos dato, eamq; uxorem habeto, quod eam subegerit, neq; unquam repudiare liceto. Deuter.22.
main_text.head: LXIX.

p.i: Si quis uxorem duxerit, fœminamq; fecerit, si contigerit eam illi non placere, quòd aliquid in ea offenderit inhone-

page.notes: Page is a Latin-language page of "Nuptiales" (marriage law text) with Deuteronomy citation. Continuation of the sentence at page foot ("inhone-") is hyphenated. Doubtful readings: "mortor" was printed as "mor tor" with a space; "virgine" and "stupru" are as printed. The printed "Deuter.22." is a marginal-style reference set in the text and transcribed as printed. Marginal notes and the header ornament were not clearly legible.
